verdict.rationale: Downloading is done from the command line, but through a Python helper script (`scripts/fetch_models.py --tier edge0-35b --target-dir models`) rather than a first-class `edge0` subcommand. Each download bundles the base checkpoint and adapters into a ready-to-run directory, and the `edge0` CLI can serve and run models by tier or path. There is no evidence of model search or of list/remove/update management commands; adapter upgrades are described only as file swaps. missing for 10: CLI model search, a native `edge0` download/pull subcommand, CLI commands to list/delete/update installed models, independent hands-on corroboration.
